notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two upper-cabinet leaves were opened and closed in rapid succession; their individual closure order and midpoints are only approximately separable within the sampled 592–608 interval. The intervening camera movement around the open refrigerator does not show a supported close-and-reopen cycle.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, separately opens both doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, closes the refrigerator, opens a top drawer beside the oven, then closes the cabinet doors and drawer.
